definitions: A line or ring of police, soldiers, or guards preventing access to an area or building.
A method of training fruit trees or shrubs by pruning them to grow as a single stem, typically horizontally or at an angle.
examples: Police formed a cordon around the building.
The cordon of security guards was impenetrable.
The chef wore a white jacket with a blue cordon.
He trained the apple tree as a cordon.
